notes.title: Stormwater - Major Update 2.1 - Mar 13th
notes.content:
Good day, all.

Did I say this update would be out in January? I meant March, of course. A slight slip of the tongue we’ll call it. Also something important to note:

*SAVE GAME WARNING FOR RETURNING PLAYERS* One hiccup during the development of this update has resulted in the fact that saves from previous versions of Stormwater will be incompatible with the updated version. If you’re a player returning to the Stormwater, be advised, old saves won’t work with this update. The previous build of the game 2.0.1 will be maintained in the beta depots. I hope to avoid this in the future, needless to say.

Now with that out of the way, Stormwater 2.1 is now out at long last, and it comes with a panoply of upgrades, including:

[b]- Thirty Five New Side Quests[/b]

Including new cutscenes for Petrus Henry, Faith, Caleb, and a certain curse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322459/1ffabdab032c719e210d605145be01f85af97907.png[/img]

[b]- Added Music Player to the Parish[/b]

Located in the kitchen of the parish, the music player is now functional, and will allow you to listen to the wonderful themes of the game as you unlock them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322459/01d3e6f36820a04e50e10fc7bb6946ff4705a798.png[/img]

[b]- Fixed the Shooting Range[/b]

The shooting range in the parish is at last functional, and resets upon reentry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322459/cdd8e4189fd4f58ddf039cd5f52aa88f3c2d3c83.png[/img]

[b]- Additional Content for the Endings[/b]

Additional pieces have been added to flesh out the various endings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322459/ee17083b8f698991c2cf117b0e192ea72b279058.png[/img]

[b]- The Stormwater Original Soundtrack is now on Steam[/b]

The Stormwater soundtrack is available for purchase here!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3482280/Stormwater__Complete_Edition_Soundtrack/]Stormwater - Complete Edition Soundtrack[/url]

[b]- Achievement Guide Available and Cheat Codes Added[/b]

Here on Steam I added a guide for the achievements and also a guide containing all of the cheat codes.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433690469] Stormwater Achievement Guide[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433763942] Stormwater Cheat Codes[/url]

[b]- Stormwater and Graceward Discount Bundle now Available[/b]

There is now a bundle available too which includes not only Stormwater, but also my previous game, Graceward, and both soundtracks, for 20% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322459/533ba8c00f90dbf98363df541808d04604e49f78.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49829/Graceward__Stormwater/]Graceward / Stormwater[/url]

- And on top of that, I rebalanced a few areas especially in the early game, made easy difficulty slightly easier, and fixed some bugs.

- Lastly, I also recorded a video with a friend of mine who was kind enough to help me put together an overview on the update, check that out if you want to see the game in action.

[previewyoutube=3Y4mDA7HVBE;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, with all that said, I may do one more update of about this size a little later on this year, however I’m also working on a new project, more to come on that, well, eventually.

If you run into any bugs or issues with update 2.1, please post them in the bug thread on the main page, or shoot me an email at thelibraryupstairs@gmail.com.

Godspeed and happy curse hunting,
Fransis

notes.title: Stormwater Update 2.0.1 - Jan 4th
notes.content:
A small update for Stormwater is now live, adding:

- Several new cutscenes to side quests for Casey the merchant, and Haynes the scholar.

- Fixes for several bugs/typos.

More content updates will be coming out over the course of the month, and also the Original Soundtrack will be made available here on Steam- more to come on that soon!

Godspeed, 
Fransis
